## Introduction

@fig-firstplot plots budget against revenue with budget as the independent varaible and budget as the dependent variable.

## Plot

```{python}
#| echo: true
#| layout-ncol: 2
#| fig-cap: "Budget against revenue"
#| label: fig-firstplot
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")

plt.scatter(films['budget_musd'], films['revenue_musd'])
```
